title: External error envelope and Problem Details
summary:
Expose P12 descriptors through the additive CoreX envelope and RFC 9457 content
negotiation without creating a second error vocabulary.
why:
`@plan/knowledge/research-P13-design.json` §8; D72/D61. P12 intentionally kept wire bytes stable and
assigned category/path/retryability/correlation publication to P13.

include:
Extended envelope/meta; Problem Details serializer; Accept negotiation/Vary;
problem type/instance; safe status/header policy; OpenAPI schemas; exact semantic parity tests.
exclude:
New error codes/categories; parsing human message; arbitrary retry policy;
HTML errors; non-API exception handler; snapshot files (P13.10).

rules:
Exact bodies and member naming from §8. Both representations consume
one mapped `ApiError/ErrorDescriptor`, have identical status/stable extensions/meta and never emit
raw exception/message/details. `application/problem+json` only when acceptable; default envelope
remains `application/json`. `Vary: Accept`, request id and no-store always. `Retry-After` only from
named bounded duration policy.
guidance:
Keep serializer implementations internal behind existing contract or an additive
contract if required; do not widen domain descriptor with HTTP fields. Use a deterministic problem
type URI builder from validated Options. OpenAPI declares both media types from shared schemas.

validation.procedure: Golden envelope and Problem Details for every P12 category share code, category, path, retryability, details, request, correlation, version and status
Human message change leaves the machine fixture unchanged
Accept q-values, wildcards and unsupported 406 stay on the default envelope
Unknown exception is a safe internal_error and raw Throwable text stays out
Retry-After is emitted only for the named rate_limit policy
API lint, static analysis, full suite and public error contract

deliverables:
Two negotiated representations over one descriptor, OpenAPI projection and
wire-parity/security evidence.

result.notes: P13.9 GREEN: JSON envelope and RFC 9457 problem details share one descriptor. Accept negotiation, Vary, and named Retry-After policy. API pest 144/1005, phpstan 0, pint passed, error-contract 3/3.

sections.title: Validation

retryability/details/request/correlation/version/status. Human message change leaves machine fixture

Throwable. Old success envelope unchanged except declared correlation addition. API lint/analyse/test.
